Gumtree UK classifieds: listing search and detail, similar listings, seller profiles with their active ads, search suggestions, trending searches, the category tree with per-category filters, and location autocomplete. A secondhand-market endpoint, so listings churn fast - re-read rather than caching a listing id for long.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/gumtree/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Gumtree's category hierarchy: id, text, seo slug, parent, and children. Omit category_id for the full tree. Pass a category id or SEO slug (cars) to get that node's subtree. Use the ids as category_id on GET /v1/gumtree/search and GET /v1/gumtree/filters.

**Use when** you want to pick a category_id for search and filters. Omit category_id for the full tree.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - Category tree is a single dump, optionally scoped to one subtree.

**Query params**

- `category_id` (optional, string) - Optional category id or SEO slug. Returns that node's subtree; omit for the full tree.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {id string, text string, idName string, seoDisplayName string}; `children[]` {id string, text string, idName string, seoDisplayName string, parentId string}; `children[].children[]` {id string, text string, idName string, seoDisplayName string, children[] object, parentId string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/filters - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the filters available on a Gumtree category (price, condition, brand, mileage, bedrooms, and so on, depending on the category), each with a name you can pass as attributes on GET /v1/gumtree/search.

**Use when** Use it after categories when you need brand, condition, mileage, or bedroom filters for a search.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - Filter definitions for one category are a single dump.

**Query params**

- `category_id` (required) - Gumtree category id or SEO slug from GET /v1/gumtree/categories. · e.g. `10205`

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data`, `{ categoryId, filters }` (inferred from a sample): {categoryId string}; `filters[]` {kind string, param string, label string, selected string, minParam string, maxParam string}; `filters[].options[]` {value string, label string}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/filters" \
  --data-urlencode "category_id=10205" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/locations - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Gumtree location matches for a place name, postcode, or outcode, each with location id, name, type, and coordinates. Feed the id into GET /v1/gumtree/search as location_id.

**Use when** you want to resolve a place name into a location_id for search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Location autocomplete returns a short non-cursored suggestion list.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Place name, postcode, or outcode, for example london or B92. · e.g. `london`
- `location_type` (optional, enum: LOCATION | OUTCODE | POSTCODE) - Optional filter: LOCATION, OUTCODE, or POSTCODE.

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.latitude` |  |
| `place.longitude` |  |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL (seen in a sample response) |
| `place.category` | Primary category… (seen in a sample response) |

Also in the sample: `place.rating` {value null, max null}; `place` {reviews_count null, price_level null, address null, phone null, verified null, description null, image_urls null}; `place.ext` {status string}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/locations" \
  --data-urlencode "query=london" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/locations/nearest - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns the Gumtree location closest to a latitude,longitude pair: location id, name, type (LOCATION or POSTCODE), and coordinates. Feed the id into GET /v1/gumtree/search as location_id.

**Use when** you have coordinates and need a location_id for search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Reverse geocode returns one nearest Gumtree location.

**Query params**

- `latitude` (optional, string) - Latitude. Use with longitude when you do not pass location_coordinate.
- `longitude` (optional, string) - Longitude. Requires latitude.
- `location_coordinate` (optional, string) - Latitude,longitude pair, for example 51.5074,-0.1278. · e.g. `51.5074,-0.1278`

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `location_coordinate`, `latitude`.
- `longitude` is a no-op without `latitude` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.latitude` |  |
| `place.longitude` |  |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL (seen in a sample response) |
| `place.category` | Primary category… (seen in a sample response) |

Also in the sample: `place.rating` {value null, max null}; `place` {reviews_count null, price_level null, address null, phone null, verified null, description null, image_urls null}; `place.ext` {status string}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/locations/nearest" \
  --data-urlencode "location_coordinate=51.5074,-0.1278" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one Gumtree listing: title, description, price, images, category, location with coordinates, seller name, and the seller ids needed for GET /v1/gumtree/seller. Pass the numeric ad id or the full gumtree.com/p/.../{id} URL. Asking prices, not sold prices. published_at is not returned because Gumtree only exposes relative age.

**Use when** you already have an ad id or a gumtree.com/p listing URL. Search first if you only have a keyword.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree advertisement id, the numeric id at the end of a listing URL: gumtree.com/p/apple-iphone/iphone-11/1515115590 is ad id 1515115590. Ad ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/gumtree/search. · e.g. `1515115590`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Gumtree listing URL, for example https://www.gumtree.com/p/apple-iphone/iphone-11-11-pro-11-pro-max-unlocked-with-warranty/1515115590. The ad id is extracted from the path.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.description` |  |
| `product.seller` |  |

+2 more (types in the full schema): `product.price` {currency, current}. Also in the sample: `product` {brand null, availability null, reviews_count null}; `product.price` {original null}; `product.rating` {average null, count null}; `product.ext` {seller_id string, condition string}; `product.ext.gumtree` {user_id string, public_user_id string, account_id string, seller_type string, category_id string, category string, location string, location_id string}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/product" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=1515115590" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

- `url` (optional, string) - Full Gumtree listing URL, for example https://www.gumtree.com/p/apple-iphone/iphone-11-11-pro-11-pro-max-unlocked-with-warranty/1515115590. The ad id is extracted from the path.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.price.currency` |  |
| `product.price.current` |  |

Also in the sample: `product` {description null, seller null, brand null, availability null, reviews_count null}; `product.price` {original null}; `product.rating` {average null, count null}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.


## GET /v1/gumtree/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Gumtree UK classifieds matching a keyword, about 22 per page, each with ad id, title, price in GBP, location, category, seller type (private or trade), image, and listing URL. Pass a gumtree.com/search URL as url to replay an existing web search (location slugs default to a 15-mile radius unless the URL carries a distance). Price, seller_type, and attributes filters only apply when category_id is also set. Paginate with page or the universal cursor until hasNextPage is false. Feed a returned ad id into GET /v1/gumtree/product for the full listing.

**Use when** you want to find UK second-hand, vehicle, or property ads by keyword. Feed a returned ad id into product for the full listing.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 22/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/22) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (optional, string) - Free-text listing search, for example iphone or golf mk7 diesel. · e.g. `iphone`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Gumtree web search URL, for example https://www.gumtree.com/search?q=iphone&search_location=london. Keyword, category, location, and price filters on the URL are parsed server-side.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-1000) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: relevance | newest | price_low | price_high) - Result ordering: relevance (default), newest, price_low, or price_high.
- `category_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree category id or SEO slug from GET /v1/gumtree/categories or search/suggestions. Required for price, seller_type, and attributes filters to take effect.
- `location_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree location id from GET /v1/gumtree/locations or locations/nearest.
- `distance` (optional, enum: 0 | 1 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 15 | 30 | 50 | 75 | 100 | 150 | 250 | 500 | nationwide) - Search radius in miles around location_id. Ignored without a location_id. nationwide searches the whole UK.
- `min_price` (optional, string) - Lowest asking price in GBP. Requires category_id. Filter on product.price.current if you need a hard bound.
- `max_price` (optional, string) - Highest asking price in GBP. Requires category_id.
- `seller_type` (optional, enum: private | trade) - Restrict to private (individual) or trade (dealer) sellers. Requires category_id.
- `attributes` (optional, string) - Category-specific filters as comma-separated name:value pairs from GET /v1/gumtree/filters, for example common_for_sale_condition:new,vehicle_make:audi. Requires category_id.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `query`, `url`.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.price.currency` |  |
| `product.price.current` |  |

Also in the sample: `product` {description null, seller null, brand null, availability null, reviews_count null}; `product.price` {original null}; `product.rating` {average null, count null}; `product.ext.gumtree` {seller_type string, category_id string, category string, location string, location_id string}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `gumtree/product` (`product_id` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get a Gumtree listing by ad id or URL.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=iphone" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/search/suggestions - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Gumtree search autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, each with the matching category and a ready-made search query string. Useful for keyword expansion before GET /v1/gumtree/search.

**Use when** you want to expand a keyword before calling search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Fixed-window autocomplete: upstream returns a single non-cursored suggestion list.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Partial search query to autocomplete, for example iph. · e.g. `iphone`
- `category_id` (optional, string) - Optional category id to scope suggestions to.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ query, category_id, category_name, search_query }` (inferred from a sample): {query string, category_id string, category_name string, search_query string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/search/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=iphone" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/seller - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns a public Gumtree seller: display name, average rating, rating count, membership caption, and last-active caption. Both seller_id and public_id are required; they come back on GET /v1/gumtree/product as product.ext.gumtree.user_id and public_user_id. A missing seller is 404 and is not billed.

**Use when** Use it with the seller_id and public_id from a product response. A missing seller is 404.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `seller_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree seller userId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.user_id). Must be paired with public_id. · e.g. `17804454`
- `public_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree seller publicUserId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.public_user_id). Must be paired with seller_id. · e.g. `13b4fddbbabbef26807a535511d79289`
- `account_id` (optional, string) - Optional Gumtree accountId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.account_id).

**Constraints**

- `seller_id` is required (it is optional in shape only - the request needs it).
- `seller_id` is a no-op without `public_id` - sending it alone is a free 400.
- `public_id` is a no-op without `seller_id` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `Seller` object at `data`, `{ seller }` ([full schema](schemas/Seller.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seller.name` | Seller name |
| `seller.rating.average` |  |
| `seller.rating.count` |  |

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/seller" \
  --data-urlencode "seller_id=17804454" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/seller/listings - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one page of a seller's active listings, about 20 per page, each with ad id, title, price, image, and listing URL. Category and location are often null on this path. Both seller_id and public_id are required. The upstream count equals the page size, so it is not returned: paginate until a page comes back short.

**Use when** you want to walk a dealer or private seller's inventory. Paginate until a page comes back short.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 20/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `seller_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree seller userId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.user_id). Must be paired with public_id. · e.g. `17804454`
- `public_id` (optional, string) - Gumtree seller publicUserId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.public_user_id). Must be paired with seller_id. · e.g. `13b4fddbbabbef26807a535511d79289`
- `account_id` (optional, string) - Optional Gumtree accountId from a listing detail (product.ext.gumtree.account_id).
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-1000) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Constraints**

- `seller_id` is required (it is optional in shape only - the request needs it).
- `seller_id` is a no-op without `public_id` - sending it alone is a free 400.
- `public_id` is a no-op without `seller_id` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.price.currency` |  |
| `product.price.current` |  |

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/seller/listings" \
  --data-urlencode "seller_id=17804454" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/gumtree/trending - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the search terms currently trending on Gumtree UK, a demand signal that cannot be derived from listings. Typically around 30 strings.

**Use when** Use it as a demand signal. Listings are supply; trending searches are what people are looking for right now.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - Upstream returns one fixed list of currently trending search terms.

**Response** `Analytics` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ query }` (inferred from a sample): {query string}.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/gumtree/trending" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
